prompt.zh-CN: 图灵测试最常被用来讨论机器是否具备哪种能力？
prompt.en-US: The Turing test is most often used to discuss whether a machine has what ability?

text.zh-CN: 表现出类似人类的对话智能

reveal.zh-CN: 图灵测试关注观察者能否通过文字对话区分人和机器。
reveal.en-US: The Turing test asks whether an observer can distinguish a human from a machine through text conversation.

prompt.zh-CN: 机器学习里的“监督学习”通常需要什么？
prompt.en-US: In machine learning, supervised learning usually needs what?

text.en-US: A teacher staring at the screen

reveal.zh-CN: 监督学习依赖输入和期望输出之间的样本关系。
reveal.en-US: Supervised learning relies on examples that pair inputs with expected outputs.

title.zh-CN: 生成式 AI 的常见输出

prompt.zh-CN: 下面哪些可以是生成式 AI 的常见输出？
prompt.en-US: Which of the following can be common outputs of generative AI?

reveal.zh-CN: 生成式 AI 可以生成多种数字内容，但不能直接生成物理规律本身。
reveal.en-US: Generative AI can create many kinds of digital content, but it cannot directly create a physical law.

title.en-US: Is a larger model always correct?

prompt.zh-CN: 判断：模型参数更多，就一定不会产生错误答案。
prompt.en-US: True or false: if a model has more parameters, it will definitely never produce wrong answers.

reveal.zh-CN: 更大的模型可能能力更强，但仍可能误解、遗漏或生成不可靠内容。
reveal.en-US: A larger model may be more capable, but it can still misunderstand, omit details, or generate unreliable content.

prompt.zh-CN: 在 AI 搜索中，把文本转成“嵌入向量”主要是为了什么？
prompt.en-US: In AI search, why convert text into embeddings?

text.zh-CN: 用数字空间表示语义相似度
text.en-US: To represent semantic similarity in a numeric space
To make file size always become zero

reveal.zh-CN: 嵌入向量让语义相近的内容在向量空间里更接近，适合检索和聚类。
reveal.en-US: Embeddings place semantically similar content closer in vector space, which helps search and clustering.
